subject: PublicRefreshCircuit
publishable_claim: PublicRefreshCircuit is executable under allow_insecure. Correctness was observed on an identified older arithmetic snapshot: five refresh cycles and five following squares, 81,920 coefficient comparisons, not a latest-head rerun. A deterministic noise certificate is published (documented 562-bit return bound against a 633-bit threshold); a probabilistic decryption-failure bound is not derived. Confidentiality of the related-key setup is not established. External parameter attestation is not obtained. Constant-time posture is not established. The circuit is not admitted for production use. Legacy Clockwork bootstrap remains disabled (issues #95 and #117).
